guilds.name: Knight
guilds.resource_rule: 100; +12 on block, +6 on basic hit; starts at 30
guilds.appearance: plate, teal cloth, cream tabard; bronze shield; short gold oath strokes
guilds.mastery_choice: Bulwark: Interpose protects two nearby allies at half strength; Duelist: Sunder gains 20% damage after a successful defence
guilds.identity: Resolve on defence makes positioning valuable; ranged kiting punishes overcommitment

guilds.name: Cyborg
guilds.resource_rule: 0–100; actions add heat; cool 8/s after 2s without spending; at 100 offence locks until 50
guilds.appearance: human face, ceramic limbs, exposed copper mechanisms; cyan coils
guilds.mastery_choice: Insulator: Coolant Burst leaves 15% ranged-damage cover for 3s; Shatter: cooled enemies take 20% more Pulse Lance damage once
guilds.identity: Manage heat bursts and vent timing; interrupts and pressure during cooling punish greed

guilds.name: Necromancer
guilds.resource_rule: 100; regenerates 7/s; enemy defeat restores 10 once per eligible creature
guilds.appearance: bone and bronze ornaments, layered black robes; pale blue spirits and violet curses
guilds.mastery_choice: Keeper: Echo lasts 8s longer but Consume heals 25% less; Reaper: Consume detonates for 0.6P within 2m
guilds.identity: Choose spirit survival or sacrifice; cleansing and summon focus disrupt setup

guilds.name: Mage
guilds.resource_rule: 100; regenerates 8/s; last two elements determine next combination
guilds.appearance: layered indigo cloth, geometric staff head, restrained elemental forms
guilds.audio: glass harmonics / air crack / small ignition
guilds.mastery_choice: Evoker: mixed-element hit gains 15% damage; Scholar: successful combination refunds 10 Mana once per 6s
guilds.identity: Prepare a sequence then cash it in; interrupt long casts and move before combinations land

guilds.name: Monk
guilds.resource_rule: 0–100; +12 on alternating basics/skills, -10 for repeating same skill; decays 5/s out of combat
guilds.appearance: sand wraps, charcoal travel clothes, beads; clean physical silhouettes
guilds.mastery_choice: Crane: successful Palm Counter gives 1s of 20% speed; Tiger: third alternating hit adds 0.35P damage
guilds.identity: Alternate actions and time counters; feints and range deny Flow

guilds.name: Priest
guilds.resource_rule: 100; regenerates 7/s; maintain one vow: Shelter reduces own damage 10% and increases healing 10%, Judgment reverses
guilds.appearance: ivory stole, practical bronze mail, open sun emblem; warm protective planes
guilds.mastery_choice: Shelter: ward expiry heals 0.3P; Judgment: Smite against condemned target grants 0.4P self shield
guilds.identity: Vow trades healing for pressure; interrupts, spread pressure and anti-heal counter sustain

guilds.name: Bard
guilds.resource_rule: 0–100; +10 per basic beat; songs spend per second; two concurrent songs maximum
guilds.appearance: rust-red coat, compact lyre and curved blade; thin rhythmic ribbons
guilds.audio: plucked strings / hand drum / restrained chord
guilds.mastery_choice: Conductor: song radius +2m; Duelist: ending two songs grants next Cadenza 0.4P damage
guilds.identity: Layer and release songs without losing position; interrupts and separation deny group value

guilds.name: Changeling
guilds.resource_rule: 100; regenerates 8/s; forms Wolf, Raven, Beetle; combat uses ground movement for all
guilds.appearance: wolf with pale crest, ground-skimming raven, plated beetle; constant amber eye motif
guilds.audio: bone shift / wing cloth / claw rhythm
guilds.mastery_choice: Hunter: Wolf Pounce marks prey for 10% bonus basic damage 3s; Wanderer: form change restores 10 Instinct once per 8s
guilds.identity: Form determines reach and escape; predict swaps, use sustained pressure during transformation

guilds.name: Elemental
guilds.resource_rule: 100; regenerates 6/s; Fire, Water, Earth, Air; swapping costs Stability
guilds.appearance: four humanoid masses with different outline crowns; feet always readable
guilds.audio: stone / steam / wind / water in matching register
guilds.mastery_choice: Anchor: Earth reduces displacement 50%; Tempest: cycling three elements empowers next basic by 0.6P
guilds.identity: Each element commits to a function; punish repeated swapping and forecast delayed zones

guilds.name: Psion
guilds.resource_rule: 100; regenerates 8/s; interrupted casts remove additional 10 Focus
guilds.appearance: dark tailored coat, suspended crystal halo fragments; lilac line distortions
guilds.audio: tuned hum / soft glass / low pressure click
guilds.mastery_choice: Anchor: Mind Bulwark returns 10 Focus on full absorption; Vector: successful displacement empowers Thought Spike by 20%
guilds.identity: Control space through anticipated lines; interrupts and cover deny setup

guilds.name: Symbiont
guilds.resource_rule: 100; regenerates 7/s; host adaptations Guardian, Stalker, Mender share HP and cooldowns
guilds.appearance: recognizable human host with amber resin tendrils, bark plates and distinct limb attachments
guilds.mastery_choice: Mutualist: Mender heals grant 0.2P shield; Predator: Stalker attacks on marked targets restore 4 Bond once per second
guilds.identity: Trade armour, reach and healing through adaptations; focus exposed host during swaps

guilds.name: Powered Armour
guilds.resource_rule: 100; regenerates 6/s when not firing; Assault, Bastion, Support configurations selected in town
guilds.appearance: broad industrial suit, visible pilot viewport, orange warning marks and massive readable feet
guilds.audio: heavy servo / cartridge slam / grounded recoil
guilds.mastery_choice: Bastion: Brace Projector lasts 1s longer; Assault: Siege Round splash +0.3P but cooldown +2s
guilds.identity: Manage power and firing commitment; flanks and line-of-sight breaks beat frontal strength

guilds.name: Adventurer
guilds.appearance: weathered linen coat, practical leather, simple iron weapon
guilds.mastery_choice: No mastery branch; choose a full guild at level five
guilds.identity: Learn movement, readable danger and interaction before specialization

bosses.mechanics: spotlight chase; mirror duet; final curtain
bosses.counterplay: Watch act placards; use shadow door to cut an add wave

bosses.name: The White Regent
bosses.description: ancient ice dragon with brass relics embedded in scales
bosses.mechanics: breath sweep; falling ice; broken wing dive
bosses.counterplay: Melt marked anchors; shelter behind durable pillars

bosses.name: The Glass Executor
bosses.description: corporate judgement chassis, many glass panels
bosses.mechanics: audit beams; confiscation drones; elevator surge
bosses.counterplay: Break declared power nodes in shown order

bosses.name: The Unwritten Captain
bosses.description: blank admiral outlined by a moving ink sea
bosses.mechanics: tidal lanes; erased platforms; authored storm
bosses.counterplay: Restore bridge names; read tide before moving

quests.recovery: choice affects dialogue and epilogue, never invalidates another player's world
